description: This file contains code for a deep learning-based stock price prediction model using LSTM, data normalization, sequence splitting, model training, and evaluation. It also includes API interactions with Alpaca for trading orders.

methods.name: setup_data
methods.description: Prepares data for LSTM model by downloading, normalizing, and creating sequences.

methods.name: normalize_data
methods.description: Normalizes dataset columns to a 0-1 range.

methods.name: split_sequences
methods.description: Splits dataset into sequences suitable for LSTM input.

methods.name: initialize_network
methods.description: Creates and compiles an LSTM neural network model.

methods.name: train_model
methods.description: Trains the LSTM model with early stopping and checkpoint callbacks.

methods.name: load_keras_model
methods.description: Loads a trained Keras model from JSON and weights files.

methods.name: evaluate_model
methods.description: Evaluates the trained model's performance on test and training data.

methods.name: create_order
methods.description: Creates a trading order via the Alpaca API.
